name: clube04-crm
description: CRM operacional do Clube04 Mogi das Cruzes.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @clube04/shared && npm run build -w @clube04/api && npm run build -w @clube04/worker && npm run build -w @clube04/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @clube04/shared && npm run lint -w @clube04/api && npm run lint -w @clube04/worker && npm run lint -w @clube04/web
scripts.verify:all: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run smoke:api && npm run verify:action-items && npm run verify:operational-summary && npm run verify:operational-worklist && npm run verify:dashboard && npm run n8n:list:workflows
scripts.n8n:import:workflows: docker compose exec -T n8n n8n import:workflow --separate --input=/workflows
scripts.n8n:list:workflows: docker compose exec -T n8n n8n list:workflow
